label: champion at full power for the UI: 8 threads, 3 s/move, games opening book
elo_note: Calibrated with 8 threads and 1000 ms time budget. Depth reach at 1s doubled from depth 6-8 to depth 12-13 through direct 1D array ray stepping, zero-alloc SEE, single-probe TT, DeepLMP, quiescence TT probing/storing, and deferred move generation. The network was retrained on 2026-09-18 on a deduplicated corpus: the five pools merged to 10,957,828 distinct positions, 4,797,515 exact duplicates dropped out of 15,755,343 read. It read +15 +/- 11 over 3,600 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.78. The same five pools with their duplicates kept read -19 +/- 20 and self-play positions alone -26 +/- 20, so the gain is the deduplication, not the extra rows.
